# Skilltech Labs

> Skilltech Labs is an AI product company and ERP provider based in the UAE, building production-ready SaaS platforms and autonomous AI systems from the ground up. Every product ships with AI built in — not bolted on. The company is operated by SKILLTECH EDUCATION AND TRAINING COMPUTER SOFTWARE L.L.C.

Skilltech Labs builds infrastructure-level software that replaces entire workflows — not just automates tasks. Products span enterprise resource planning, business automation, ecommerce, fleet management, HR and payroll, applicant tracking, fintech, career tools, and parental monitoring.

The company has two flagship platform products: SkillTech ERP (a live, multi-tenant HR and payroll platform with UAE WPS compliance) and AI OS (a fully autonomous AI-powered business operating system with ten specialized agents).

## Products

- [SkillTech ERP](https://erp.skilltechlabs.com): Live, production-ready multi-tenant HR and payroll ERP. UAE WPS compliant. Features include attendance tracking, leave management, WPS-compliant payroll processing, PDF payslip generation, bulk employee import, department and designation management, role-based access control, multi-company support, and a super admin panel. Built for UAE, GCC, India, and Pakistan. 14-day free trial available at erp.skilltechlabs.com/register. Powered by FastAPI, PostgreSQL, Redis, and Celery.

- [AI OS](https://skilltechlabs.com/products/ai-os): Fully autonomous AI-powered business operating system. Ten AI agents — Orchestrator, Research, Strategy, Content, Technical, Design, Execution, Analyst, Optimization, and Memory — replacing marketing, sales, leads, CRM, research, operations, and account management teams. Runs 24/7 with zero salaries and zero human error on repetitive tasks.

- [CVBuddy](https://skilltechlabs.com/products/cvbuddy): WhatsApp-based AI CV generation system powered by Claude AI. Users upload their old CV or provide details conversationally and receive a polished, professional CV instantly. No subscriptions — pay per result.

- [Ecommerce Engine](https://skilltechlabs.com/products/ecommerce-engine): Production-ready single-tenant ecommerce platform. Launch a full online store in minutes by providing store details. Fully integrated with local shipping agents for automated last-mile delivery. Includes WhatsApp shopping (browse, choose variants, pay, and get delivered entirely inside WhatsApp), AI product search and chat, secure checkout, and complete policy pages. Live tenant: shop.millco.in

- [FleetScan](https://skilltechlabs.com/products/fleetscan): Multi-tenant car rental SaaS platform. Bookings, fleet tracking, vehicle management, and smart operational insights in one system.

- [CardFlow](https://skilltechlabs.com/products/cardflow): Multi-POS transaction management SaaS for businesses running multiple payment points simultaneously. One dashboard for every POS, every transaction, every location — with automated reconciliation and ledgering.

- [Recruitment ATS](https://skilltechlabs.com/products/recruitment-ats): Scalable multi-tenant applicant tracking system. Track every applicant across the full recruitment pipeline. Built to scale with any recruitment operation.

- [AngelEye](https://skilltechlabs.com/products/angeleye): Parental monitoring platform for tracking and protecting children's digital activity. Full monitoring capabilities built from scratch.

- [WhatsApp English](https://skilltechlabs.com/products/whatsapp-english): Hybrid AI-powered English learning system delivered entirely through WhatsApp. No app to install. Designed for real people, built for real results.

## Key Facts

- 9 products built from scratch, all production-ready
- AI integrated into every product — not as an add-on
- SkillTech ERP is live with 14-day free trial at erp.skilltechlabs.com
- UAE WPS compliant payroll — built for UAE, GCC, India, and Pakistan
- Based in UAE — SKILLTECH EDUCATION AND TRAINING COMPUTER SOFTWARE L.L.C
- Specializes in WhatsApp-native product delivery and autonomous agentic systems
- Live ecommerce tenant: shop.millco.in (organic food products, Kerala, India)
- Two platform-level products: SkillTech ERP (business infrastructure) and AI OS (AI automation)

## Technical Capabilities

- Multi-tenant SaaS architecture with strict tenant isolation
- Autonomous agentic AI systems (10-agent orchestration)
- WhatsApp-native commerce and service delivery
- UAE WPS and GCC payroll compliance
- Event-driven architecture with background job processing
- RBAC and ABAC access control systems
- Regional compliance: UAE, GCC, India, Pakistan
